title: pfr operation
description: Plug-flow reactor. The volume is integrated by RK4; nSteps controls the spatial discretisation. Isothermal, adiabatic, or cooled through a wall (on the multi-reaction path a multitubular bed with a coolant of its own).

V_R.title: Reactor volume
V_R.description: Total reactor volume; RK4 integrates over the residence-time interval [0, V_R / Q_feed]. Required unless `tubes.length` is declared (then the volume is N pi d_i^2/4 L, and V_R beside it is REFUSED -- one home).

nSteps.title: Integration steps
nSteps.description: Axial steps along the tube; defaults to 100.

writeInterval.title: Profile write interval
writeInterval.description: Write every Nth step to the axial profile; 0 (default) writes none.

thermalMode.title: Thermal mode
thermalMode.description: isothermal (default), adiabatic, or heatExchange — the last removing U·(a/V)·(T − T_coolant) along the tube. Any other word is REFUSED.

U.title: Wall coefficient
U.description: The OVERALL wall coefficient, declared. With `thermalMode heatExchange`, required unless `wallHeatTransfer` computes it (the two are exclusive).

areaPerVolume.title: Heat-transfer area per volume
areaPerVolume.description: Tube surface per unit reactor volume. Required by `thermalMode heatExchange` unless `tubes` gives it (4/d_i; then it is REFUSED).

T_coolant.title: Coolant temperature
T_coolant.description: The constant coolant temperature of the legacy form. Required by `thermalMode heatExchange` unless a `coolant {}` block is declared (then it is REFUSED).

catalystLoading.title: Catalyst loading
catalystLoading.description: Mass of catalyst per unit reactor volume.

L_over_D.title: Bed slenderness L/D
L_over_D.description: Multi-reaction path only. Gives the bed a cross-section (D, L, A published as KPIs) as the straight cylinder of V_R at this ratio; the `pfr` sizer builds the shell on it and REFUSES a second L_over_D in its designRules -- one home. Required by `pressureDrop`.

diameter.title: Bed diameter
diameter.description: Multi-reaction path only (DEV.md 4c C69). Gives the bed a cross-section of DECLARED diameter: L = V_R / (pi D^2 / 4), published with D_bed_declared_m. The form a multibed converter's beds take, all reading one plant variable (the converterShell refuses a bed at its own L_over_D). `L_over_D` or `tubes` beside it are REFUSED.

catalyst.title: Catalyst particle
catalyst.description: The particle the bed is packed with, read by the Ergun `pressureDrop`. (Until 2026-10-12 a dysonSimon1968 bed's Eq 39 read it too; since DEV.md 4c C67 a rate law is written in the case and declares its own particle as a parameter of its formula.) No default.

particleDiameter.title: Particle diameter
particleDiameter.description: Taken by Ergun as the equivalent-sphere diameter (an irregular granule's sieve size overstates it: the drop is then a lower estimate). No default.

shape.title: Particle shape
shape.description: Read by the `wallHeatTransfer` correlation (Li & Finlayson has one form per shape, with its own window). No default.

pressureDrop.title: Bed pressure drop (opt-in)
pressureDrop.description: Multi-reaction path only. Integrates Ergun's dP/dz = -[150 mu (1-eps)^2 u/(eps^3 dp^2) + 1.75 rho (1-eps) u^2/(eps^3 dp)] along the bed with the species, on the L_over_D cross-section; the rate law and T read the local P and the outlet leaves at P_in - dP. Needs a declared transport (viscosity) model. Absent, the bed is at constant pressure.

model.title: Correlation
model.description: Ergun, Chem. Eng. Prog. 48 (1952) 89. Any other word is REFUSED.

voidFraction.title: Bed void fraction
voidFraction.description: No default: the drop goes as (1-eps)/eps^3.

allowable.title: Allowable drop
allowable.description: Optional design budget; a drop above it is ANNOUNCED (never clamped) with the (L/D)^2 remedy.

tubes.title: Catalyst tubes (multitubular bed)
tubes.description: Multi-reaction path only (DEV.md 4c C69). The bed is N parallel tubes: area per volume 4/d_i, the cross-section N pi d_i^2/4 (Ergun runs per tube), the volume N pi d_i^2/4 L. `L_over_D` or `areaPerVolume` beside it are REFUSED.

count.title: Number of tubes
count.description: May be real (an outer driver solves it); the sizer rounds it UP to whole tubes.

length.title: Tube length
length.description: Fixes the bed volume; exclusive with `V_R` (absent, V_R gives the length).

wallThickness.title: Tube wall thickness
wallThickness.description: With `wallConductivity`, puts the wall's resistance in series with the bed side; both or neither. Needed by the sizer (the outside diameter).

wallHeatTransfer.title: Bed-to-wall coefficient (correlation)
wallHeatTransfer.description: `thermalMode heatExchange` only. The bed side of U from a packed-tube correlation object at the LOCAL gas (needs `tubes`, `catalyst { particleDiameter; shape; }`, a `coolant { film; }` and transport viscosity + thermalConductivity), in series with the wall and the coolant film. Exclusive with a declared `U`.

model.title: Correlation
model.description: Li & Finlayson, Chem. Eng. Sci. 32 (1977) 1055 -- the 1-D overall coefficient U_w (read in Iordanidis, PhD thesis, Univ. Twente 2002). Any other word is REFUSED.

coolant.title: Coolant
coolant.description: `thermalMode heatExchange` only (DEV.md 4c C69). boiling: one temperature T_in. coCurrent / counterCurrent: a sensible coolant marched with its own energy balance (counter-current is SHOT, announced). `T_coolant` beside it is REFUSED.

arrangement.title: Arrangement
arrangement.description: How the coolant flows; named, never defaulted.

flow.title: Coolant mass flow
flow.description: Total, all tubes. Sensible coolant only (refused when boiling).

utility.title: Utility record
utility.description: A SENSIBLE utility record whose mean cp (dutyPerKg / |T_in - T_out|) is used, announced. Exclusive with `cp`.

film.title: Coolant film coefficient
film.description: Declared; required with `wallHeatTransfer`, refused beside a declared overall `U`.
